results.reader_title: UNCTAD reviews shale gas across global energy markets
results.reader_what: This UNCTAD report surveys unconventional gas production, environmental concerns and international developments, with some European policy comparisons.
results.reader_more: UNCTAD positions the report as a global perspective on shale gas, largely motivated by the United States production boom, energy pricing and environmental trade-offs. The table of contents also includes European gas market pricing and European shale production experiences. These comparative chapters do not turn the complete work into a European geoeconomic security assessment.

deep_analysis.main_finding: UNCTAD compares shale gas markets, production viability and policy choices across North America, Europe, Asia and other regions.
deep_analysis.method_or_basis: Official UNCTAD publication landing page with substantive research-scope explanation; official PDF table of contents cross-checks chapter distribution. The full PDF was blocked for extraction.
deep_analysis.qualification: The global and environmental framing does not support strong Europe-specific dependency or national security implications without the full evidence.
deep_analysis.radar_relevance: Its comparative European energy-market content may be background, but is too diffuse for a central Europe economic-security Radar item.
